entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand Pulse monitor. It's a piece of junk and I want my money back. Now.

I'm very sorry to hear you're not satisfied with the VeloBand Pulse. I can certainly look into the return options for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

I don't have time for a thousand questions! It's inaccurate, the battery sucks, and I'm done with it. I've had it for about 25 days and I want to return it. Your website says 10 days, so just process it.

I understand your frustration. I just need to clarify a few things. Because the Pulse band is a wearable device that makes direct skin contact, our return policy can be a bit more specific due to health and sanitation reasons.

Sanitation? Are you kidding me? Are you saying I'm unhygienic? I've heard it all now! Your policy is your policy! Don't you try to weasel out of it with some 'hygiene' excuse. This is unbelievable. Get me your manager, right now!

Sir, my apologies, I didn't mean to imply anything at all. Please give me just one moment to pull up the official return policy article in our knowledge base. I want to be absolutely sure I'm giving you the correct information.
You better be. I'm about to light up your Twitter feed with this 'hygiene' nonsense. Unbelievable customer service.

Okay, I have the documentation in front of me now... and, you are absolutely correct. My apologies. The policy clearly states a 10-day return window. Since you received it 25 days ago, you are unfortunately outside that period. It's not too late at all. I can process this return for you immediately.
See? There. That's what I've been saying. Should have just done that from the start instead of wasting my time.

You're right, and I apologize for the confusion. I've just initiated the return. I'm sending a pre-paid shipping label to the email address on your account now. Just package the item in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off. You'll see the full refund within 5-7 business days of us receiving it.
Fine. Make sure that email comes through.
It has just been sent. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
